title: Emanon Wanderer
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Emanon, a young woman who carries the memories of every ancestor since life began on Earth, wanders the small country towns of late-1960s Japan and changes the lives of the people she meets. In one story she talks with a boy about kappa folklore and meets a time-traveling friend; in another she learns that, for the first time, she has a twin brother. When love again leads to pregnancy, she faces the start of a new cycle in which one of her children is, for the first time, a boy.
life_message: Memory, nature and brief human encounters connect every life to a vast continuity.
